purpose: Positive control for the Stage 4B oscillation index, no external data: can the GPi index reach 1.5 when a known 12 Hz rhythm is imposed on STN, or on GPi directly, in the frozen Stage 4A model?

imposed_rhythm.definition: Each step adds (1 - exp(-dt/tau_cell)) * A * sin(2*pi*f*t) to every cell of the target group, with one shared phase: the cell's equilibrium potential oscillates by A mV.

isolated_gpi: GPi cells of the same seed with all synapses removed, normal-state biases and noise, no imposed rhythm.

criteria.R1_gpi_reachable_via_stn: In the PD state, at some STN amplitude where the 12-seed mean STN index is >= 1.5, the mean GPi index is also >= 1.5.
criteria.R2_gpi_metric_can_register: With the rhythm imposed on GPi directly (PD state), the mean GPi index reaches >= 1.5 at some amplitude up to 8 mV.

interpretation_rules: R2 fails: the index cannot register a GPi rhythm of this size in this model, so the GPi part of Stage 4B test 2 was not attainable as designed.
R2 passes and R1 fails: the index works for GPi, but the model circuit does not pass an STN rhythm to the GPi population at the threshold level; the bottleneck is transmission.
R1 and R2 pass: the GPi criterion is attainable, and the Stage 4B failure reflects the absence of an STN rhythm at the frozen loop gains.
